stemMd: Three alarms ring every 12, 18 and 30 minutes. They ring together at noon. When will they next ring together?
explanationMd: The next coincidence occurs after the least common multiple of 12, 18 and 30. Their prime factors require 2², 3² and 5, giving 180 minutes. Three hours after noon is 3:00 p.m.; smaller proposed intervals fail at least one alarm.

distractorRationale.e: Thirty minutes is not a multiple of twelve or eighteen.
distractorRationale.d: Sixty minutes is not a multiple of eighteen.
distractorRationale.c: Ninety minutes is not a multiple of twelve.
distractorRationale.a: Six hours is a common multiple but not the first one.
